about: Scamurai evaluation set: 30 hand-written messages in the style of real Indian SMS/WhatsApp texts. Labels: genuine (should not be flagged), scam (should be flagged HIGH_RISK or SUSPICIOUS), ambiguous (not enough to decide: should be UNVERIFIED or SUSPICIOUS, never HIGH_RISK or LOW_RISK). Phone numbers in scam and ambiguous messages are made up. Official numbers and domains in genuine messages are real.
